title: Daljeet Kaur's pouches in pairs and in threes
description: Two blocks of butter milk pouches, one packed in pairs and one packed in threes, with no numbers written.

topic_name: Equal Groups: Many Ways to Make a Total
title: 36 pouches, 4 rows of 9 and the same pouches turned
description: Two arrays of 36 butter milk pouches, 4 rows of 9 and 9 rows of 4, with a turn arrow between them.

title: 7 rows of 12 packets and 12 rows of 7 packets
description: Two arrays of 84 butter packets, 7 rows of 12 and 12 rows of 7, with the number of groups and the group size marked and 7 × 12 = 84 and 12 × 7 = 84 written under them.

title: 37 moves left on the place value board
description: A place value table with 37, then 370 and then 3,700, each digit tile one more place to the left.

title: 60 × 70 is 42 hundreds
description: An array of 42 blocks marked 100, 6 rows of 7, beside the sentences 60 × 70, 6 × 7 = 42 and 42 hundreds = 4,200.

title: 6 rows of 14 split into 10 columns and 4 columns
description: An array of 84 butter packets, 6 rows of 14, split into a block of 10 columns and a block of 4 columns, with 6 × 10 = 60, 6 × 4 = 24 and 60 + 24 = 84 written under it.

title: 8 rows of 13 cut in the middle and put side by side
description: An array of 104 butter packets, 8 rows of 13, cut across the middle and put side by side as 4 rows of 26, with 8 × 13 = 104 and 4 × 26 = 104 written beside them.

title: Six rows of 19 squares in a frame of 20
description: A tray of 6 rows of 19 amber squares with a dashed empty column of 6 squares at the end, showing the squares that 6 × 20 counts by mistake.

title: The box for 23 × 14
description: A box with 20 and 3 along the top and 10 and 4 down the side, the four cells 200, 30, 80 and 12, the column sums 280 and 42, and the total 322.

title: Kanti's lines and John's lines for 26 × 13
description: Two panels for 26 × 13: four coloured lines 18, 60, 60 and 200 on the left, and two lines 18 + 60 = 78 and 60 + 200 = 260 on the right, both ending in 338.

title: The carries of 176 × 24
description: A ledger for 176 × 24 with the carry circles 2 and 3 for the ones row and 1 and 1 for the tens row, the rows 704 and 3,520 and the total 4,224.

title: One more column, one row less
description: Two arrays of squares: 7 rows of 14 with one extra green column of 7 squares, and the same array with its last row of 14 squares drawn dashed as the row taken away.

title: The village dairy counter
description: A long village dairy counter with five cards on it: a crate of 12 pouches in 3 rows of 4, a tray of 24 packets cut in the middle, a place value board showing 38 times 10, a 2 by 2 box for 12 times 13, and a ledger with three lines of working.
